testResults.name: repository-lock-and-quality
testResults.result: uv lock --check, repository Ruff lint, Ruff format across 341 files, and ty all passed.

testResults.name: repository-pytest
testResults.result: 830 tests passed in 78.78 seconds; one existing Starlette/httpx deprecation warning was emitted.

testResults.name: package-build
testResults.result: The wheel contains the split backtest runner and recorder packages, the look-ahead guard, sandbox lint, and the wired backtest CLI.

testResults.name: architecture-and-docs
testResults.result: Markdownlint passed repository.md, README.md, and the local market-lake runbook; canonical uv command and Ruff/ty-only tooling rules were codified in AGENTS.md and the instruction files.

testResults.name: local-benchmark-entrypoint
testResults.result: uv run backtest-job --config config/harness/backtest.yaml runs end to end over the built-in deterministic synthetic fixture and produces byte-identical artifacts across repeated runs; the committed example config fails cleanly with StrategyLoadError until the T097 reference strategy lands.

integrationHistory: The two large implementation modules (2096-line runner, 1416-line recorder) were split into behavior-preserving submodule packages with mirrored test splits; all 36 runner and 27 recorder tests were kept without assertion changes.
One integration failure (CLI no-args stderr assertion and four lint findings) was fixed, after which the full repository pass and build succeeded on the permitted final rerun.
limitations: The repository suite emitted the existing Starlette/httpx TestClient deprecation warning.
T089 remains CLEO-blocked by the deployed-dev T048 smoke prerequisite; its code and all acceptance criteria are verified.
